messages:
Leila (People Ops): Heads-up: new short-term PTO advance pilot is live. Managers can approve up to 5 days advance for urgent situations. Docs + request form: https://intranet.redwood/people/pto-advance-pilot

Marcus (HRBP): Effective when?

Leila (People Ops): Effective immediately. Pilot runs 6 months; we
collect usage metrics.

Jin (Eng Manager): Approval SLA? And coverage guidance?

Leila (People Ops): Managers should respond within 48h. Coverage: 1) post to team rota, 2) ask backup/oncall, 3) request temp help via staffing-ops if needed.

Jin (Eng Manager): If it's a production-critical role, can we deny?

Priya (People Ops): Safety & law first. If denying risks someone
or breaks leave law, approve and escalate staffing to eng-sre.

Ava (Payroll): Repayment: employee chooses (a) reduce future accrual over next 3 pay periods or (b) one-time payroll deduction. Intl restrictions noted.

Sophia (Legal): Note: some countries need written consent for deductions. See region matrix in doc.

Leila (People Ops): Travel disruption support added: up to $500 for emergency rebooking/hotel with receipts. Submit to travel-expenses@redwood with "PTO-ADVANCE".

Marcus (HRBP): Can advances >5 days be approved?

Priya (People Ops): >5 days requires level-2 review (manager + HRBP + People Ops). Follow escalation flow in the doc.

Oncall-bot: Reminder: update oncall rota 24h before PTO start or notify eng-oncall.

Leila (People Ops): Questions or edge cases ping me or Marcus. Thanks! :clap:
